# Runtime and Data Checklist: Connection Monitor

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for the always-on monitor, outage rules, and saved data
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the time limit per check given as a number, not only "shorter than the interval"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the public host used for the name lookup check named? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "success" defined per check type (for example, which HTTP status counts as success)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior defined when no default router can be found (no network interface up)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the lowest allowed interval stated for the changeable interval? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "length" of an outage defined as end minus start, with "end" the first round where the state is gone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "failed targets" in the report defined as all targets that failed in any round of the outage? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the format of the report's start time filter specified (date, date-time, relative)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the time zone and format of times in the report and CSV specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Does the DNS down rule (§FR-008) agree with the internet down rule when both general checks and the name lookup fail together? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the GitHub down rule exclude rounds where the internet is down, so one cause is not reported twice? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the "no data" gap rule (§FR-011) agree with SC-003's "no gaps except sleep or shutdown"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can SC-004's CPU and growth limits be measured with a stated method and period? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Is SC-001's "within 30 seconds" tolerance consistent with a 30-second round interval? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Recovery and Exception Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Is the behavior defined when the data file cannot be written (disk full, file locked)? [Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the behavior defined when two monitor processes start at the same time? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Is restart behavior after a crash defined for an outage that was open before the crash? [Recovery, Spec §FR-011]

## Privacy

- [ ] CHK018 Is it stated that saved error text may contain local network details (router address) and stays local? [Assumption, Spec §FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by the `specify` procedure and the `clarify` procedure
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
